title: Pretty and bright. Way too expensive @ $54
text:
Pretty and bright. Way too expensive @ $54. this is a very nice curtain. The color is accurate and bright. The description needs to be changed though. It says curtains with an s as in more than one curtain. There is only one curtain in the package. The price of $54 is ridiculous for only one panel. It should be no more than $25 per panel.

I love the length and with the width being so wide, i will be able to use it on one window without needing a second one.

product_metadata.title: PARASOL Indoor/Outdoor Curtains for Patio - St Kitts 52" x 95" Thermal Insulated Single Panel Grommet Top Light Blocking Water Resistant Curtain Shade for Backyard, Cinnabar
features: Versatile enough for both indoor and outdoor spaces - porches, patios, sunrooms, and more
Easy to slide decorative rust-proof grommets
Mix and match solids, prints, stripes and sheers
description: Bring indoor elegance to outdoor spaces with Parasol St. Kitts indoor/outdoor curtains. This versatile collection of decorative curtains is designed to offer both fashion and function for the home. Inspired by the latest fashion trends the St. Kitts collection features geometric lattice print in bright color combinations. Fade resistant fabric makes them perfect for the patio, sunroom or gazebo. Ideal for all outdoor spaces, these water-repellant curtains are durable enough to hold their beauty through rain, wind, or shine. Easy-to-slide rust-proof grommets offer a modern flair that will hold up against the elements. 1.65 inch grommets accommodate up to a 1 inch rod. Curtain rod sold separately. Extra-Wide 52 inch panel in your choice of 84 or 95 inch length. Easy care, machine wash, tumble dry, do not bleach.
